inner_role_rule: Only original fold0 known-artist queries: SHA256(seed+NUL+decimal component_id), full digest modulo5==0 calibration; all other buckets fit. Whole original components; no reshuffling.
model: Existing single positive-only Gaussian unchanged hyperparameters; normalization, positive means/variances and prevalence from inner-fit only. Never refit after calibration.

thresholds.method: Worst positive rank within each inner-calibration component, missing score vocabulary_size+1; ceil((n+1)*0.8) order statistic. Unsupported labels abstain.

external_evaluation: Original validation and test only after saved model and thresholds freeze. Both previously inspected, diagnostic only. No model/threshold selection or repeated optimization.
unknowns: No fabricated positives, verified negatives, musical probabilities, cross-provider identities or listener judgments. Report all raw/known/missing-feature/unlabeled/cold/rare/unseen counts.
